entry: Run set up for Glymph 0.4.0rc2 (0.4.0rc1 plus the cross-check between the two rules for the tested pairs). Two passes over 54 libraries; CellBender 0.4.0, Glymph 0.3.2, Glymph 0.4.0rc1, scAR, SoupX and DecontX outputs linked and scored again.

Both passes, scoring of all 54 libraries and the collection finished without a failed task. 0.4.0rc2 equals 0.4.0rc1 on every library but one: over the 54, the share of counts removed differs by more than 15% only on bd_demo_pbmc (2.2% against 17.1%; 0.3.2 5.4%; CellBender 2.0%), the one library where the rule settled at the start was used.

Mixtures never used in development (12), 0.4.0rc2 against CellBender 0.4.0 (0.3.2 in brackets): cross-species removal 88.6% and 88.5% in the two runs (85.7%) against 83.4%; same-species removal 1.01 of the amount measured inside cells (0.97) against 0.83; per-cell error with the measured truth 0.0193 (0.0201) against 0.0465, with the benchmark's extrapolation 0.0171 (0.0159) against 0.0433; rank agreement 0.69 (0.65) against 0.55. All 27 mixtures: higher removal than CellBender on 18, lower per-cell error on 27 (26 by the extrapolation), higher rank agreement on 24. By platform: 10x cell lines 93.7% against 91.5%, xenografts 81.4% against 69.4%, BD Rhapsody 93.0% against 92.6%, Parse 80.2% against 62.3%, nuclei mixture 79.8% against 32.3%. Held-out libraries where CellBender removes more: xeno_HSC_2 (64.1% against 77.6%; no silent-gene estimate), hgmm_10k_5p_gemx (96.8% against 97.5%), hgmm_20k_5pv2_HT (86.5% against 87.0%), hgmm_10k_3p_chromX (95.7% against 96.0%).

Kidney (5 libraries, genotype truth): per-cell error 0.0900 (0.3.2: 0.0892) against 0.0971; rank agreement 0.382 (0.377) against 0.368; removed over truth 1.05 (0.99) against 0.96; tubule markers removed from other cell types 88.0% (85.9%) against 83.1%, kept in tubule cells 87.8% (87.9%) against 86.7%. Tissue without truth (22 libraries): 4.9% of counts removed on average (0.4.0rc1 5.5%, 0.3.2 7.1%, CellBender 9.0%), marker counts kept in their own group 99.0% (98.8%; CellBender 95.0%), removed from the other groups 16.8% (20.1%; CellBender 12.7%).

Cells stripped far beyond their true background, 27 mixtures, 164,497 cells: 144 and 149 in the two runs (0.4.0rc1 143; 0.3.2 9; CellBender 4,206; scAR 9,704; DecontX 854; SoupX 6); 140 of them on xeno_noHSC_2, where 3.4% of the counts are removed against a truth of 1.9% (2.6% with the measured split). The cross-check does not touch that library (the two rules agree there). Against the measured truth the count is 82. Resources: median 98 s per library, 1.87 GPU-hours per pass (CellBender 2,135 s and 34.5 GPU-hours), 3.2 GB of RAM.

Fits that carry a warning in 0.4.0rc2 (show_fit_health.py): xeno_HSC_2 has no silent-gene estimate; hgmm_1k_v2 and parse_hgmm_sub2 rest on a single cluster, the second with a ridge of 3.5 and 12% of its cells set aside; xeno_HSC_3 has 19% of its cells set aside (human cells in mouse clusters, as 0.3.2 found). parse_bm_hfd is as in 0.4.0rc1, with two or more of its eight sublibraries near 2,000 background counts at the median depth against 240 to 390 in the others.

Where 0.4.0rc2 stands for the request (much better than CellBender before anything is published). Clearly ahead: every mixture platform on average, per-cell accuracy by a factor of 2.4 to 2.7 on the held-out mixtures, 29 times fewer over-stripped cells, 22 times faster, integer output that never exceeds the raw counts, two runs that agree. Level: kidney tissue (error 0.090 against 0.097). Behind or unsound: one held-out xenograft without an estimate, over-stripping of 140 cells on another, the Parse bone marrow sublibraries, the BD mixture's dirty cells (still 91.4% against 92.6% on bd_hgmm_mix1). Not published at the time of writing.
